title: Inside the coding-agent harness
scope: Curated public research report. Original frozen outcomes, subsequent development, fresh validation, and synthetic controls remain separate.

baseline.population: Purposively selected Python issues in Django, SymPy and scikit-learn

earlier_development_runs.label: development-1
earlier_development_runs.status: Unscorable in frozen checks; cause needs review

limits: Purposive sample of Python projects; recent fix dates do not imply recent discovery.
Selected behavioral checks, not full project suites.
Same model/settings do not isolate native system-prompt, context-management or tool differences.
Manual judgments remain missing until reviewed; outcomes and trace completion are separate.

followup.population: Four inspected development issues and two fresh SymPy issues; one attempt per agent, issue and variant. No model-weight training.

limits: Source inventory detects net changes, not every transient write or process side effect.
Recorded native tool calls are not a complete provider HTTP/tool-schema capture.
A missing phase due to timeout is not counted as a completed read-only phase.

later_development.status: Stopped by user; no automatic resume; the later four-issue fresh Test was unused.

publication_limits: This export includes aggregate outcomes, every original held-out attempt, source revisions, curated follow-up audit fields and source-document hashes.
Raw native streams, provider payloads, credentials, full local paths, experimental harness code, hidden tests and unused holdout answers are not published.
Source-document hashes identify retained records; they do not make unpublished captures independently replayable from this export.
The initial held-out issues became development data after inspection. Later development findings never change their original frozen scores.
Model reasoning or understanding is not inferred from source text appearing in a tool result.
